classes.name: Daggers, claws and rapiers
classes.who: Sacrifice Knife, the three claws, Frostmourn Rapier, the Spellbound Rapier
opts: No hit-stop, no shake: the blade passes through.
A tiny catch on every hit, a little more on a heavy.
Barely there: felt more than seen.
classes.why: Fast weapons hit often: a catch of 25 ms keeps them quick but lets each hit land.

classes.name: Swords and maces
classes.who: Mistblade, Windcutter, Storm Blade, Grief Blade, Gravebell Mace
opts: A short catch on each hit; a heavy stops a beat and shakes a little.
Big catches and a hard shake on heavies.
classes.why: The middle weight: you should feel it bite, but never feel slowed down.

classes.name: Greatswords, axes, hammers, scythes and halberds
classes.who: Keyhammer, Glacier Greatsword, Sealbreaker, Arcane Maul, every scythe, Riverstone Halberd, Wyrmspine Pike, Eclipse Edge, Dragon Slayer, Alduin's Bane
opts: Each blow stops a beat; a heavy stops longer and shakes the screen.
classes.why: Big weapons should feel big: the stop sells the weight, the shake sells the power attack.

classes.name: Wands, staffs and flasks
classes.who: Carian Wand, Radiant Quarterstaff (its bolts), Soulcaller's and Mutagen Staffs, the Wandering Star, the flasks
opts: No stop on casts; a small shake when a great bolt lands.
A short stop and a shake on each great bolt.
classes.why: Spells hit far from you: stopping the screen on them feels wrong, but a shake on the big ones lands.

marks.name: The hit marker
marks.now: A white mark at the crosshair on a hit, gold on a headshot, red and bigger on a kill, with a bright tick.
opts: Keep the mark, a softer tick

marks.name: A headshot
marks.now: A brighter tick, a white flash at the crosshair; a headshot kill bursts the head.

marks.name: A kill
marks.now: The body gives way (our sound) where it falls.
opts: Louder, so you hear it in a crowd
Its death's own sound (The dead tab)

marks.name: The last of the night
marks.now: Nothing special: the night ends when the last one falls.
opts: A moment of slow motion on the last kill
A flash and a low boom on the last kill
